# push-can-be-disabled-stays-local

The publisher supports a configuration option to disable pushing; when push is disabled a publish can create a local commit but will not create or update the branch on the remote.

Allow running publishes that modify local history without affecting the remote, useful for dry-runs or environments where pushing is undesirable.
